notes: This contract pins Umbra's opt-in, non-installable IEEE 1516.1-2025 nonregional object-class Request Attribute Value Update development slice to the exact C++ class-designator request and Provide Attribute Value Update callback declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies only the official signatures, declared exception sets, adapter symbols, and real Catch2 selectors. The slice validates the class and attributes at that class, expands over currently registered instances at the requested class and its subclasses, groups currently owned requested attributes per provider and object instance, does not require a requester-known instance, does not invoke a requester for attributes it owns, propagates the user tag, and rechecks a queued provider before callback delivery. A focused filesystem case also proves one provider report per expanded instance before callback user code. A separate class-expansion response case now invokes the official timestamped Update Attribute Values service from the provider callback and checks reflection; it remains explicit federate code rather than automatic provision, with those timestamped/retraction surfaces pinned by the dedicated timestamped attribute-update API contract. The separate class-level regional request form is traced by attribute-value-update-with-regions contracts. Broader timestamped/retraction behavior, DDM beyond that sibling slice, update-rate reduction, ownership transfer, FOM sharing-policy enforcement, save/restore, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
